notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.8
notes.content:
Patch Notes 1.0.8

Changes

 Added Help Chip system to Charms
 Added Full Set bonus to Charms
 Added Cursed Charms
 Improved the Charm generation system
 Added a filter function to the Charm list
 Added some How to Play


Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the “Rich” Enchant caused incorrect drop amounts under certain conditions

notes.title: The Problem with the Charm Puzzle System and My Plan to Fix It
notes.content:
Hello! 
I've noticed that the recently implemented Charm system isn't quite delivering the gameplay experience I aimed for. 
Specifically, in the puzzle system:

 Many accessories can't be fully set.
 Sometimes, the effect tiles can't be filled.
 To reduce Max Energy, you need to fill red tiles.

To address these issues, I'm planning to adjust the puzzle mechanism while keeping the Charms themselves unchanged!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44991802/868f5f3faf22deac6ff50b3a8196a962c3d51c08.png

I will keep updating DigDigDrill, so please look forward to it!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.6
notes.content:
Changes

 Added a Charm system that lets you adjust stats like max energy
 Added a system to inspect multiple Haniwas at once

notes.title: Next Update: What's Coming?
notes.content:
Hello!  Thank you for playing DigDigDrill.

Sorry for the lack of updates.  Right now, I'm working on implementing a system to adjust energy and other stats, as mentioned in a previous post.  Also, the drill is getting a stylish upgrade!

I'm planning to release it this month!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.5
notes.content:
Changes

 Added a VSync setting.
 Added a shortcut key to close the window when reaching the bottom.
 Adjusted the appearance of some UI elements.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the number of items in the bag displayed in the Esc menu was incorrect.


Note: What is VSync?
If you notice screen tearing or choppy visuals, turning it ON may help improve the issue.

notes.title: DigDigDrill Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello! The full version of DigDigDrill is finally released!
Dive into the world of digging and enjoy the pure fun of mining!

What’s next?
Here are some features planned for future updates:
*Controller support (including compatibility with Steam Deck)
*Adjustments to allow gameplay using only a mouse
*Addition of a skill tree and high-difficulty levels

How to transfer data from the demo version
When you open the full version, a “GetDemoData" button will appear in the top-right corner of the screen.
(If you accidentally started the full version from scratch, delete the full version's save data to make the "GetDemoData" button appear.)
